extracted.intended_audience: regulated entities (dairy industry stakeholders), legal practitioners, and other readers of Federal Register rulemaking documents
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register correction notice correcting an inadvertent error in a previously published final order (specifically correcting a compliance date for an FDA rule revoking/amending yogurt standards). It is an official-styled rulemaking document showing required metadata and correction language.

rubrics_metrics.name: FederalRegister.gov legal status / verification
rubrics_metrics.description: This site displays a prototype of a “Web 2.0” version of the daily Federal Register. It is not an official legal edition of the Federal Register, and does not replace the official print version or the official electronic version on GPO’s govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Those relying on FederalRegister.gov for legal research should verify their results against an official edition of the Federal Register. The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice or judicial notice until the Administrative Committee of the Federal Register (ACFR) grants it official status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official editions provide legal notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using public inspection listings or prototype displays for legal research, verify contents against a final, official edition published on govinfo.gov or in print.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard document section headings
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register documents typically contain the following headings: AGENCY; ACTION; SUMMARY; DATES; FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT; SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These headings are standard structure for drafting Federal Register documents; the Table of Contents on FederalRegister.gov is a navigational tool and repetition of headings has no substantive legal effect. See the Document Drafting Handbook for more details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document metadata fields required/displayed
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents include metadata such as Agencies; Agency/Docket Number; CFR (title and part); Document Citation (e.g., 88 FR 31608); Document Number; Document Type; Page; Publication Date; Effective Date; and contact information for further information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide and display clear metadata (docket number, CFR part, FR citation, document number, effective date) so readers can locate and verify the official record (including link to the official PDF on govinfo.gov).

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction format and content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Corrections identify the original Federal Register publication (date and FR citation and FR Doc number), state the specific location of the error (page, column, heading), and provide the corrected text (e.g., 'On page 22908, in the first column, under DATES, the compliance date is corrected to read: "January 1, 2024"').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A correction should precisely cite the original FR Doc and specify where the change is made, present the corrected language, include the signature block with the date, and include the FR Doc filing/billing code information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comments and docket status disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Comments: the document indicates whether comments are being accepted (e.g., 'Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rulemaking documents should state the comment status and direct readers to the DATES section and the docket on Regulations.gov for context and any related comment activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of supporting documents and references
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Documents: list of references and supporting materials (e.g., scientific references, proposed orders, bibliographies) are provided and linked (the page shows 'See all 30 supporting documents').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear list of supporting documents and references to substantiate rulemaking actions and to allow stakeholders to review underlying materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of machine-readable and alternative formats
rubrics_metrics.description: The document is available in multiple formats (JSON, XML, MODS) and includes a link to the official PDF on govinfo.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide machine-readable formats and links to official electronic PDFs so researchers and developers can access metadata and the official text; direct users to developer tools/documentation as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection notice and relationship to final official edition
rubrics_metrics.description: Public Inspection: the PDF is described as 'FR Doc. [number] as it appeared on Public Inspection on [date].' The note advises verifying contents against a final, official edition of the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When relying on public inspection listings, confirm the finalized official edition for authoritative text and citation.
